svg.aria-label: Left: the squares of a missing south wing with W on its own axis and S on the south side of C, at v = 0.2, s = 0.1, d = 0.75, in the smallest disk that allows these separations (radius 1.742); the separating lines of the stress with the weights 41/20, 1, 3/8, 1, 1 and its forces; the force on S points along the bisector of its two unit forces. Right: the domain of (v, d), shaded by the profile without the angle of S, with the lower bounds of Table D.9 for both faces at the corners; the dashed line d = 11/14 separates the third and the first cone for S
